title: fix: multipart Gemini speech without a format defaults to wav
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Multipart `/v1/audio/speech` requests to Gemini TTS without `response_format` now use the existing per-model default of wav instead of failing with a 400 caused by the form parser's mp3 default. JSON requests already defaulted to wav; multipart requests for other models still default to mp3. A route test covers the multipart Gemini case.
